notes: Counts are participants with fatal or non-fatal atrial fibrillation, not episodes. Within this outcome only, OG000 identifies Omega-3 and OG001 identifies Placebo Omega-3; these IDs differ from those used for other outcomes in the same file. Omega-3 pools Omega-3+Aspirin and Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin; Placebo Omega-3 pools Placebo Omega-3+Aspirin and Placebo Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin. Each constituent arm is described as including 3870 participants, but atrial fibrillation counts are reported only for the pooled groups. The outcome denominator is explicitly 7740 participants per pooled group without an explicit randomized/analysed qualifier in that outcome record. No arm-specific atrial fibrillation percentages are printed.
